name: School Love Story | Chapter 2
source:
Exams are over! The main characters are finally going to a summer camp at the sea! Sun, sand, sea... what could be better? You will find out what surprises, secrets and what romantic stories will unfold on the seashore.

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.OrionStudio.Anime_School_Love_Story_2]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
考试结束了！主角们终于要去海边夏令营了！阳光、沙滩、大海……还有什么比这更好的呢？你会发现，海边将会发生什么惊喜、秘密、浪漫的故事。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.OrionStudio.Anime_School_Love_Story_2]Google Play[/url]]
